title: Law to require ferry service at Canarsie Pier
summary: This bill would require the City to establish and maintain regular ferry service at Canarsie Pier in Brooklyn, integrated with the existing NYC Ferry system where practicable. It would take effect one year after becoming law. The bill was discussed at an October 20, 2026 joint committee hearing on ferry service alongside similar bills for Willets Point, West 125th Street and City Island.
